sloka: ते गात्रयोर्निपतिता रुक्मपुङ्खाः शरा युधि।असृङ्नद्धा विनिष्पत्य विविशुर्धरणीतलम् ।। ६.८९.३३ ।।
transliteration: te gātrayornipatitā rukmapuṅkhāḥ śarā yudhi।asṛṅnaddhā viniṣpatya viviśurdharaṇītalam ।। 6.89.33 ।।

translations.english: Glorious and powerful heroes, determined to win over each other, wounded by the gold covered iron arrows were bleeding profusely.
